description: Installs the git-compact CLI -- compacts and prunes local git repositories. Sourced from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alimtvnetwork/git-compact/main/install.ps1 (UNIX equivalent: .../install.sh).

messages.notAdmin: This script requires admin privileges. Please run as Administrator.
messages.notFound: git-compact not found -- will install now
messages.notInPath: git-compact installed but not found in PATH (may need shell restart)
messages.verifyMissing: 'git-compact' not found on PATH after install -- refreshing environment...
messages.verifyRefreshed: PATH refreshed from registry. Entries added: {count}
messages.verifyFinalFail: Could not run 'git-compact --version' after install. Open a NEW terminal and re-run.
messages.disabled: git-compact install is disabled in config
messages.remoteInstallerFailed: Remote installer failed -- falling back to ZIP download
messages.uninstallFailed: {name} uninstall failed -- package may need manual removal.
messages.uninstallComplete: Uninstall complete. Package removed, tracking purged.

commands.check: Verify the installed binary responds to --version
commands.uninstall: Uninstall completely, remove tracking, clean up

flags.-Tag <ref>: Pin a git ref (branch / tag / commit) on alimtvnetwork/git-compact (e.g. main, dev, v1.2.0). Substituted into installUrl/releaseZipUrl. Default: main.
flags.-Help: Show this help text and exit.
